body: He was in the stand for the first half. At the interval his phone went and he took it standing up.
He was not there for the second half, which is the half you scored in.

choices.text: Ask whether he saw the goal.
choices.outcome_text: Ruslan says he will send him the clip. The clip is eleven seconds long and has no context in it.
In the changing room somebody says it was a good finish. It was a good finish.

body: They have signed a nineteen-year-old on a three-year deal. The announcement uses the word future twice.
You are twenty-four. Nothing in the announcement is about you and nothing in it needs to be.

choices.outcome_text: He replies with a thumbs up inside a minute. You remember doing that at nineteen.
You open it again that night to check the age and it has not changed.

items.notes: 08 §8: the wage ceiling around ₽100,000 and competing on argument.

body: There is a ceiling on the wage and you are under it. There is also a ceiling on the number of contracts.
The second one is the one that matters, and nobody put it in writing until August.

choices.outcome_text: Twenty-two. They have twenty-two. He turns the screen so you can count them yourself.
He says to keep in touch. He gives you a number that is the club's main line.

body: The man who wanted you has taken a job in the division above with two weeks left of the window.
He took his assistant and his fitness coach. He did not take a squad list.

choices.text: Message him to say well done.
choices.outcome_text: He answers in three days and the answer is warm and it is three lines and it is the end of it.
You watch his first game on a phone in the kitchen. They lose and he looks pleased anyway.

body: Two of them came and both of them stayed to the end. There was nothing in the way this time.
Afterwards one of them tells you what he thinks, kindly, in the tunnel, with his coat already on.

choices.text: Ask how far off you are.
choices.outcome_text: He thinks about it properly before he answers, which is worse than if he had not.
They say it was no trouble. It was four hundred kilometres and they mean it was no trouble.
